assertions.title: Tab navigation preserves restaurant context

steps.action: Sign in, open /email-delivery?restaurantId=a050d1ad-1ee0-4ea0-abc2-22c3778aa52c, and capture the Delivery Log tab
steps.expected: Email Delivery loads with the selected restaurant context visible in the authenticated surface
steps.observed: The page loaded at /email-delivery?restaurantId=a050d1ad-1ee0-4ea0-abc2-22c3778aa52c with the Email Delivery title and the restaurant text 'The Old Crown Girton' present in the DOM.

steps.expected: Queue content opens, restaurant context stays selected, and tab change occurs without a full page reload
steps.observed: Queue opened at /email-delivery?restaurantId=a050d1ad-1ee0-4ea0-abc2-22c3778aa52c&tab=queue with queue filter controls visible, and the restaurantId stayed unchanged. Performance entries recorded a route-level _rsc fetch to /email-delivery?...&tab=queue&_rsc=l0zkx.

steps.action: Switch to the Analytics tab and inspect navigation behavior
steps.expected: Analytics opens with the same restaurant context and without a full page reload
steps.observed: Analytics opened at /email-delivery?restaurantId=a050d1ad-1ee0-4ea0-abc2-22c3778aa52c&tab=analytics with KPI tiles visible, and the restaurantId remained unchanged. Performance entries again recorded _rsc fetches to /email-delivery?...&tab=analytics&_rsc=l0zkx, so the no-full-page-reload requirement was not met.

evidence.consoleErrors: none; observed warnings only: Next.js scroll-behavior warning and Supabase Multiple GoTrueClient instances warning
evidence.network: RSC fetches observed via performance entries: GET /email-delivery?restaurantId=a050d1ad-1ee0-4ea0-abc2-22c3778aa52c&tab=queue&_rsc=l0zkx and GET /email-delivery?restaurantId=a050d1ad-1ee0-4ea0-abc2-22c3778aa52c&tab=analytics&_rsc=l0zkx

assertions.issues: Restaurant context was preserved across tabs, but tab changes still triggered route-level _rsc fetches instead of a purely client-side tab swap.

steps.action: Inspect the page header on Delivery Log, Queue, and Analytics tabs
steps.expected: Header shows Email Delivery title, restaurant name badge, timezone badge, and Go to bookings link across all tabs
steps.observed: All three tabs showed the Email Delivery title, Go to bookings link, and a timezone badge rendered as 'UTC'. The restaurant text 'The Old Crown Girton' was present in the header area/DOM across the tested tabs.

evidence.consoleErrors: none; observed warnings only: Next.js scroll-behavior warning and Supabase Multiple GoTrueClient instances warning
evidence.network: Authenticated header surface loaded at /email-delivery?restaurantId=a050d1ad-1ee0-4ea0-abc2-22c3778aa52c and persisted through tab URLs

assertions.title: Error state

steps.action: Open /email-delivery?restaurantId=a050d1ad-1ee0-4ea0-abc2-22c3778aa52c&tab=delivery-log&messageId=__force_error__ on the authenticated real surface
steps.expected: An error alert with a meaningful message is displayed when the delivery API returns an error
steps.observed: The page loaded with the normal header and filter shell only. No alert text or error message was visible in the DOM or body text.

steps.action: Verify the API response for the same fault-injection path from the authenticated browser session
steps.expected: The API request returns an error that should drive the UI alert
steps.observed: A direct fetch to /api/ops/email-delivery?restaurantId=a050d1ad-1ee0-4ea0-abc2-22c3778aa52c&messageId=__force_error__ returned HTTP 418 with {"ok":false,"code":"FORCED_ERROR","error":"Forced delivery log error for dev/test validation.","message":"Forced delivery log error for dev/test validation."}.

evidence.consoleErrors: none; observed warnings only: Next.js scroll-behavior warning and Supabase Multiple GoTrueClient instances warning
evidence.network: GET /api/ops/email-delivery?restaurantId=a050d1ad-1ee0-4ea0-abc2-22c3778aa52c&messageId=__force_error__ -> 418 {"ok":false,"code":"FORCED_ERROR","error":"Forced delivery log error for dev/test validation.","message":"Forced delivery log error for dev/test validation."}

assertions.issues: The documented fault-injection path is active on the authenticated surface, but the UI did not render any visible error alert or message for the forced API error.

frictions.description: After password sign-in, the app left the session on a non-email-delivery route, so the assigned page had to be opened explicitly.
frictions.resolution: Navigated directly to the assigned Email Delivery URL after the authenticated session was established.

summary: Retested 3 assertions on the authenticated real surface: 1 passed (VAL-CROSS-005) and 2 failed (VAL-CROSS-001 due to route-level _rsc fetches on tab changes, VAL-DL-017 because the forced 418 API error did not render a visible UI alert).
